title: Remove a host key from known_hosts
summary: Delete the stored SSH key for a specific host from your known_hosts file. Use this if a server's key has changed and you are getting a warning.

steps.explain: Remove the stored key for a specific remote host from the known_hosts file.

placeholders.name: REMOTE_HOST
placeholders.description: The hostname or IP address of the server whose key you want to remove.

steps.expect: The tool confirms that the entry for the host has been removed from known_hosts.
